description_en: Updates an OSS-HDFS data shipping job
kebab_example: aliyun sls update-oss-hdfs-export --project my-project --oss-export-name export-osshdfs-1234567890-123456 --display-name my-oss-hdfs-job --description Update_OSS-HDFS_delivery_task --configuration example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateOSSHDFSExport

parameters.help_en: The unique name of the job. Make sure that the job exists
parameters.help_zh: 已存在的唯一任务名称
parameters.name: oss_export_name

fields.help_en: The start time for the export, specified as a Unix timestamp. Set to 1 to export from the earliest available data in the Logstore
fields.help_zh: 时间范围开始，值设为1则表示将从日志库中第一条数据开始
fields.name: from_time

fields.help_en: The name of the source Logstore
fields.help_zh: Logstore名称
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The ARN of the Resource Access Management (RAM) role that Log Service assumes to read data from the Logstore. You must specify the ARN of your role
fields.help_zh: 读SLS RAM角色roleArn，请填写您自己的角色roleArn
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en: The name of the destination OSS bucket
fields.help_zh: OSS Bucket
fields.name: bucket

fields.help_en: The time in seconds to buffer data before exporting. The value must be an integer from 300 to 900
fields.help_zh: 投递时间，取值范围为300~900，单位为秒
fields.name: buffer_interval

fields.help_en: The amount of data in MB to buffer before exporting. The value must be an integer from 5 to 256
fields.help_zh: 投递的文件大小，取值范围为5~256，单位为MB
fields.name: buffer_size

fields.help_en: The compression type for the exported files. Valid values: `snappy`, `gzip`, `zstd`, and `none` (no compression)
fields.help_zh: 支持4种压缩类型，如：snappy、gzip、zstd、none
fields.name: compression_type

fields.help_en: Format-specific settings. The structure of this JSON object depends on the `contentType` value
fields.help_zh: OSS文件内容详情，注意：该参数值为JSON格式并且应受contentType参数值的不同进行更新
fields.name: content_detail

fields.help_en: The format of the files stored in OSS. Valid values: `json`, `parquet`, `csv`, and `orc`
fields.help_zh: OSS文件存储支持4种格式，如：json、parquet、csv、orc
fields.name: content_type

fields.help_en:
The delivery delay.

This parameter is deprecated
fields.help_zh:
延迟投递时间
该字段废弃使用
fields.name: delay_sec

fields.help_en: The delivery delay, in seconds. This value cannot exceed the data retention period of the source Logstore
fields.help_zh: 延迟投递时间，设置的时间不能超过目标Logstore的数据保存时间
fields.name: delay_seconds

fields.help_en:
For Object Storage Service (OSS): The OSS internal endpoint. You must use an endpoint in the same region as the Logstore. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html. The endpoint must use the HTTPS protocol.

For OSS-HDFS: The OSS-HDFS internal endpoint. You must use an endpoint in the same region as the Logstore
fields.help_zh:
OSS Endpoint，只能是OSS内网Endpoint，仅支持同地域。详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31837.html，值为0。
OSS-HDFS Endpoint，只能是OSS-HDFS内网Endpoint，仅支持同地域
fields.name: endpoint

fields.help_en: The path format for exported files. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/371934.html
fields.help_zh: 分区格式，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/371934.html
fields.name: path_format

fields.help_en: The type of the path format
fields.help_zh: 分区格式类型
fields.name: path_format_type

fields.help_en: The prefix for files exported to the OSS bucket
fields.help_zh: OSS文件前缀
fields.name: prefix

fields.help_en: The ARN of the RAM role that Log Service assumes to write data to the OSS bucket. You must specify the ARN of your role
fields.help_zh: 写OSS RAM角色roleArn，请填写您自己的角色roleArn
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en: The suffix for the exported files
fields.help_zh: OSS文件后缀
fields.name: suffix

fields.help_en: The time zone used for the path format. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375323.html
fields.help_zh: 时区，详情参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/375323.html
fields.name: time_zone

fields.help_en: The configuration of the destination OSS sink
fields.help_zh: 投递OSS配置
fields.name: sink

fields.help_en: The sourceSecureTransport
fields.help_zh: The sourceSecureTransport
fields.name: source_secure_transport

fields.help_en: The end time for the export, specified as a Unix timestamp. Set to 0 to run the task continuously until it is stopped
fields.help_zh: 时间范围结束，值设为0则表示任务会一直运行，除非任务被手动停止
fields.name: to_time

parameters.help_en: The configuration details of the job
parameters.name: configuration

parameters.help_en: The display name of the job
parameters.name: display_name

schema.title_en: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。
schema.title_zh: 是否长链接。取值包括：  close：不是长链接，则每个HTTP请求都会重新建立TCP连接。 keep-alive：长链接，TCP连接建立后保持连接状态，节省连接所需时间和带宽。

schema.title_zh: 返回的响应体的内容格式。

schema.title_zh: 服务端产生的标识，该请求的唯一ID。
